message.content: Confirmed — I have the pre-found failing scenario. I'll triage it by shrinking to a minimal reproduction and investigating the cause.
The scenario shrinks down to a single hover body overlapping wall 0. Now I'll replay it and inspect the states around the violation to pinpoint the failure.

The probe is being driven into a thin wall and accumulating deep overlap without bouncing away. I'll try counterfactual tweaks to confirm what prevents the penetration.
I've identified that sustained thrust overwhelms the contact resolver and confirmed a low-force variant avoids the issue. I'll submit the full triage report now.
